summary: Reference for the Bone Driven Controller node, which uses one axis of a source bone motion (with multiplier or curve) to drive another bone, a morph target or a material parameter, e.g. shoulder pads following an arm.
gotchas: Operates in Component Space
Multiplier is ignored when a Driving Curve is set; zero multiplier or no motion types gives no motion

summary: Reference for the Copy Bone node, which copies translation, rotation and/or scale from a source bone to a target bone in a chosen space, e.g. moving a weapon bone to the other hand.
Reference for the Hand IK Retargeting node, which corrects IK hand bones when sharing animations across characters with different proportions by weighting toward left or right FK hand.
Reference for the Look At skeletal control, which rotates a bone (e.g. head) toward a target bone or world location with axis, clamp and interpolation options.
Reference for the Modify Curve node, which adds pins for animation curves and blends, scales or remaps their values at runtime, e.g. driving a material hue shift curve with a sine wave.
Reference for the Observe Bone debug node, which displays a bone translation, rotation and scale values in the AnimGraph in a chosen space.
Reference for the Spline IK node, which fits a bone chain (spine, tail) to a spline with control points, roll, twist, stretch and offset that can be driven dynamically.
Reference for the Spring Controller node, which gives a non-animated bone springy secondary motion with stiffness, damping, displacement limits and an error reset threshold.
gotchas: Error Reset Thresh resets the bone after large jumps such as teleports

summary: Reference for the Trail Controller node, which gives a bone chain (tail, cape) delayed trailing motion with relaxation curve, stretch, rotation and planar limits, fake velocity and debug drawing.
gotchas: Use Max Delta Time to clamp delta time and avoid stretching hitches

summary: Reference for the Transform (Modify) Bone node, which sets translation, rotation and scale of a bone with Ignore/Replace/Add modes in world, component, parent or bone space.
gotchas: Operates in Component Space; needs a space conversion

summary: Reference for the Twist Corrective node, which outputs an animation curve or morph target value from the twist angle between a base frame bone and a twist frame bone, with a worked neck/head example.
gotchas: Operates in Component Space
Max Angle in Degree cannot exceed 180

summary: Reference for bone compression codecs (bitwise, least destructive, per-track, remove every second key, linear keys, trivial keys), bitwise ACF formats, and curve compression codecs used by Animation Compression Settings assets.
